tailoring.headline: SAP CX Specialist & Senior Commerce Developer | 5+ yrs SAP Commerce Cloud
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, REST/OCC APIs, and end-to-end PIM-ERP-MDM integrations. Proven record in business analysis, stakeholder collaboration, agile delivery, CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes, and AI-assisted development. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer, fluent in English, based in Karlsruhe.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP CX Manager
cover_en.hook: I am excited by IgniteSAP’s vision to accelerate customer experience transformation on SAP CX platforms. With over five years designing and delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical and functional expertise that aligns perfectly with the SAP CX Manager role.

bullets.label: Integration Expertise
bullets.text: Led end-to-end PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines and resolved ERP/MDM integration bottlenecks, ensuring consistent product information across global channels.

bullets.label: API Development
bullets.text: Designed and exposed OCC REST web services for headless commerce, enabling seamless storefront and third-party integrations.

bullets.label: Business Analysis
bullets.text: Collaborated with international business stakeholders to translate requirements into user stories, functional specs, and scalable SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & CI/CD
bullets.text: Managed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) and mentored junior developers within Scrum teams.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, holds a valid German work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, available to start 16 December 2026. Open to remote, hybrid or on-site work.

tailoring.why_company: IgniteSAP is at the forefront of shaping next-generation SAP CX experiences, combining deep platform expertise with a culture of continuous innovation. Your commitment to delivering measurable business value through rapid, customer-centric implementations resonates with my passion for translating complex integration challenges into scalable, high-performance commerce solutions. Joining IgniteSAP would allow me to contribute my SAP Commerce Cloud background while growing within a team that drives industry-leading CX transformation.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to help IgniteSAP accelerate CX innovation by applying my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise, strong integration background, and proven business-analysis skills to deliver high-impact solutions for your clients.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of experience in integration and CX projects. I’m eager to discuss how I can contribute to IgniteSAP’s SAP CX Manager role. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for SAP CX Manager – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP CX Manager position at IgniteSAP. With over five years of hands-on experience delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for global enterprises, I am confident I can add immediate value to your team.

I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit for the role.

Best regards
